purpose: Faculty views own project portfolio and the selected project's status, history, approval history, audit trail and financial records.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated through Fusion and owns at least one ongoing and one completed RSPC project with recorded approval history.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the project portfolio, then selects one of own projects.
expected_result: Portfolio lists the Faculty member's ongoing and completed projects; the selected project's current status, project history, approval history, audit-trail entries and financial transaction records are returned; project state is unchanged.

purpose: Changing the selected project/filter refreshes the view within the same authorized scope.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and owns two RSPC projects; another Faculty member owns a third project.
action_or_input: Faculty views project 1, then changes the selection/filter to project 2.
expected_result: View refreshes to show project 2 data; only the Faculty member's own projects appear; no project state changes.

purpose: Access to a project outside the Faculty member's authorized scope is denied.
preconditions: Faculty A is authenticated; project P belongs to Faculty B and Faculty A has no RSPC access to it.
action_or_input: Faculty A requests the detail view of project P.
expected_result: Access is denied (no project P data returned); project P is unchanged.

purpose: Requesting a non-existent record reports that no corresponding record is available.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; no project exists with the requested identifier.
action_or_input: Faculty requests a project record with a non-existent identifier.
expected_result: RSPC reports that no corresponding record is available (not-found response); no record is created or altered.

purpose: Faculty submits a valid research proposal; it is recorded as Submitted and routed to the first review stage.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized for proposal submission.
action_or_input: Faculty creates a proposal with objectives, timelines, budget, funding source and resource requirements, then submits it.
expected_result: Validation passes; proposal is recorded in Submitted state, routed to the first review stage of the proposal path (HoD) and available to that reviewer; a proposal-submission notification event is triggered.

purpose: Faculty may save and revise a draft before submission.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized for proposal submission.
action_or_input: Faculty saves a proposal as draft, then revises one field (e.g. title/objectives) and saves again without submitting.
expected_result: Draft is saved in a draft (unsubmitted) state; the revision is persisted; the proposal is not routed to any review stage.

purpose: A proposal needing correction stays unsubmitted until corrected, then can be submitted.
preconditions: Faculty has a draft proposal with a mandatory field (e.g. budget) missing.
action_or_input: Faculty submits the incomplete draft; then supplies the missing field and submits again.
expected_result: First submission is rejected and the proposal remains in draft/unsubmitted state; after correction the submission succeeds and the proposal is in Submitted state.

purpose: Submission is blocked when mandatory fields are missing.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a proposal missing a mandatory field (e.g. funding source).
expected_result: Submission is blocked with a validation error; no proposal is advanced beyond the submission stage; any existing draft is preserved unchanged.

purpose: Unauthorized proposal submission is blocked.
preconditions: User is authenticated but lacks the Faculty proposal-submission authorization (or is unauthenticated).
action_or_input: User attempts to create/submit a research proposal with all fields filled.
expected_result: Request is rejected as unauthorized/forbidden; no proposal is recorded or submitted.

purpose: HoD records a positive departmental recommendation and the request is forwarded to the next stage.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated and authorized; a research proposal is at the HoD department-review stage.
action_or_input: HoD opens the request and records a 'recommend' decision with remarks.
expected_result: Request and project details are displayed to HoD; recommendation and remarks are recorded; request is forwarded to the next applicable stage (RSPC Admin verification); review/pending-action notification event triggered.

purpose: HoD records a non-recommendation; the request is not advanced as recommended.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated and authorized; a research proposal is at the HoD department-review stage.
action_or_input: HoD records a 'not recommend' decision with remarks.
expected_result: Non-recommendation outcome and remarks are recorded; request state reflects the non-recommendation and is not forwarded to RSPC Admin verification; non-recommendation notification event triggered.

purpose: For consultancy, the HoD review stage is used only when represented in the approval path.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated; a consultancy request whose represented path includes the department-review stage is at HoD review.
action_or_input: HoD records a 'recommend' decision on the consultancy request.
expected_result: Recommendation is recorded and the consultancy request advances to the next represented stage.

purpose: Unauthorized review is blocked.
preconditions: A research proposal is at HoD review; the acting user is not the authorized HoD (e.g. the submitting Faculty).
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to record a departmental recommendation.
expected_result: Action is rejected as unauthorized/forbidden; request state and data remain unchanged.

purpose: A request not in HoD-review state cannot be acted on by HoD.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated; a proposal is in draft (or already past HoD review).
action_or_input: HoD attempts to record a recommendation on that proposal.
expected_result: Action is rejected (invalid state); prior request state and data remain intact.

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies a complete request and forwards it to the approving authority.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated and authorized; a complete research proposal recommended by HoD is in the verification state.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin opens the request and records a positive verification outcome.
expected_result: Completeness/compliance information is displayed; verification outcome is recorded; request is forwarded to the Dean-RSPC stage; pending-action notification event triggered.

purpose: A consultancy request without a department stage reaches verification directly.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a consultancy request whose represented path has no HoD stage has been submitted.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin verifies the consultancy request as eligible.
expected_result: The request is verifiable without a prior HoD recommendation; verification outcome recorded and the request is forwarded to the approving authority.

purpose: An incomplete/non-compliant request is not forwarded as eligible.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a request in verification state is found incomplete/non-compliant.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a negative (ineligible) verification outcome.
expected_result: Outcome is recorded; request is not advanced to the Dean-RSPC stage.

purpose: Unauthorized verification/forwarding is blocked.
preconditions: A request is in verification state; the acting user lacks RSPC Admin authorization (e.g. Faculty or HoD).
action_or_input: User attempts to record verification and forward the request.
expected_result: Action is rejected as unauthorized; request state unchanged.

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves a request within delegated limits.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated and authorized; a verified request within delegated limits is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC opens the request with its review/compliance history and records approval with remarks.
expected_result: Review/compliance history is displayed; approval is recorded; request enters the approved state; approval notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC forwards a request requiring Director action.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; a request requiring Director action under the represented path is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC forwards the request to Director.
expected_result: Forwarding action is recorded; request enters the Director-stage state; escalation/pending-action notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC rejects a request and the decision outcome is recorded.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; a request is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records a rejection with remarks.
expected_result: Rejection decision is recorded; request enters the rejected state; rejection notification event triggered.

purpose: Director routing threshold is applied only when represented/configured.
preconditions: A Director-routing threshold is configured in RSPC; two requests at the Dean-RSPC stage, one below and one above the threshold.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC acts on both requests.
expected_result: Request above the configured threshold is routed to Director; request below it can be approved at Dean-RSPC.

purpose: Unauthorized Dean-RSPC decision is blocked.
preconditions: A request is at the Dean-RSPC stage; acting user is not Dean-RSPC (e.g. HoD or Faculty).
action_or_input: User attempts to approve the request.
expected_result: Action is rejected as unauthorized; request state unchanged and auditable.

purpose: A request outside the Dean-RSPC stage cannot be decided by Dean-RSPC.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; a request is at HoD review (not yet at Dean-RSPC stage).
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC attempts to approve it.
expected_result: Action is rejected (invalid state); request state and data unchanged.

purpose: Director approves a request routed to the Director stage.
preconditions: Director is authenticated and authorized; a request has been forwarded to the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director opens the request with prior review/verification history and records approval with remarks.
expected_result: Prior history is displayed; Director decision recorded; request reaches the terminal approved state; approval notification event triggered.

purpose: Director rejects a request routed to the Director stage.
preconditions: Director is authenticated; a request is at the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director records a rejection with remarks.
expected_result: Director decision recorded; request reaches the terminal rejected state; rejection notification event triggered.

purpose: Director routing depends on request type/threshold of the represented path.
preconditions: A large-funding/high-value request of a represented type (e.g. financial request above the configured threshold) is at the Director stage.
action_or_input: Director approves the request.
expected_result: The represented Director-approval requirement is applied; the request reaches its terminal approved state only after the Director decision.

purpose: Unauthorized Director action is blocked.
preconditions: A request is at the Director stage; acting user is not Director (e.g. Dean-RSPC).
action_or_input: User attempts to record the Director decision.
expected_result: Action is rejected as unauthorized; request and prior review records unchanged.

purpose: A request not routed to the Director cannot be decided by the Director.
preconditions: Director is authenticated; a request is at the Dean-RSPC stage (not routed to Director).
action_or_input: Director attempts to approve it.
expected_result: Action is rejected (invalid state); request state unchanged.

purpose: Faculty registers and submits a consultancy project.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized for consultancy registration.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a consultancy record with client details, scope, deliverables, timelines and financial terms.
expected_result: Consultancy is recorded as submitted and positioned at the next applicable approval stage of the represented path.

purpose: Consultancy is routed to HoD when a department-review stage is represented.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; department-review stage is represented for consultancy.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a complete consultancy record.
expected_result: Consultancy record is routed to the HoD review stage.

purpose: Unauthorized consultancy registration is blocked.
preconditions: User lacks Faculty consultancy-registration authorization.
action_or_input: User attempts to register a consultancy project.
expected_result: Request rejected as unauthorized; no consultancy record created.

purpose: A consultancy record failing required validation is not advanced.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a consultancy record missing required information (e.g. client details).
expected_result: Submission is rejected with a validation error; record is not advanced beyond submission.

purpose: Faculty tracks consultancy payments, deliverables, settlements and histories.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and owns a registered consultancy record with recorded payment/deliverable/settlement entries.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the consultancy project tracking view.
expected_result: Recorded payment, deliverable and settlement status plus approval and financial history are returned; no state changes.

purpose: RSPC Admin or Dean-RSPC may view the same consultancy histories.
preconditions: A consultancy record exists; RSPC Admin and Dean-RSPC are authenticated with their roles.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin and Dean-RSPC each open the consultancy tracking view.
expected_result: Both receive the consultancy tracking/history information within their role scope.

purpose: Unauthorized access to consultancy tracking is blocked.
preconditions: Consultancy record belongs to Faculty A; Faculty B has no access.
action_or_input: Faculty B opens the consultancy tracking view.
expected_result: Access is denied; no tracking data returned.

purpose: Tracking does not execute external payment or settlement.
preconditions: Consultancy record with pending payment/settlement status exists.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the tracking view.
expected_result: Payment and settlement statuses are unchanged after viewing; no payment/settlement execution action is performed by RSPC.

purpose: Faculty submits a project-based staff appointment request.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized; an RSPC project of the Faculty exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a staff-appointment request with the represented information, linked to the project.
expected_result: Request is recorded as submitted and available to the next appointment-processing stage (RSPC Admin).

purpose: Unauthorized staff-appointment submission is blocked.
preconditions: User lacks Faculty authorization.
action_or_input: User attempts to submit a staff-appointment request.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; no request recorded.

purpose: Submitting an appointment request does not perform HR/payroll execution.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a valid staff-appointment request.
expected_result: Only the RSPC request record/status is created; no HR/payroll execution is performed.

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies an appointment request, manages its records and forwards it.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a submitted, complete staff-appointment request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records operational records (advertisement, applications, stipend structure, duration, compliance) and a positive verification outcome.
expected_result: Operational records and verification outcome are stored; request is forwarded to the next selection/approval step.

purpose: Operational appointment records can be updated as the process progresses.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; an appointment request with existing operational records is in process.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin updates an operational record (e.g. appointment duration or stipend record).
expected_result: Update is saved and reflected in the appointment request's records.

purpose: An incomplete/ineligible appointment request is not forwarded.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; an incomplete appointment request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a negative verification outcome.
expected_result: Outcome recorded; request is not forwarded to the selection/approval step.

purpose: Appointment processing does not execute HR/payroll.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; appointment request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records stipend/payment-related records and verifies the request.
expected_result: Records are stored as RSPC records only; no HR/payroll execution is performed.

purpose: Faculty submits a fund-utilization/expenditure request routed to RSPC Admin.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; an RSPC project with fund context exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits an expenditure request with type and represented details.
expected_result: Request is recorded as submitted and routed to RSPC Admin initial verification.

purpose: Unauthorized financial-request submission is blocked.
preconditions: User lacks Faculty authorization for the project.
action_or_input: User attempts to submit a fund-utilization request.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; no request recorded.

purpose: Submitting a financial request does not execute bank payment or ledger operations.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a valid expenditure request.
expected_result: Only the RSPC request record is created; no payment/disbursement/ledger operation is executed.

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies a financial request, logs it, and forwards it.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a submitted complete financial request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a positive financial verification outcome and forwards it.
expected_result: Verification result is recorded in the financial audit trail; request advances to the Dean-RSPC approval stage.

purpose: An ineligible/incomplete financial request is not forwarded.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; an incomplete financial request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a negative verification outcome.
expected_result: Outcome recorded; request not advanced to the approval stage.

purpose: Financial verification does not execute accounting/payment.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a submitted financial request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin verifies the request.
expected_result: Only verification status/audit records change; no accounting or payment action is executed.

purpose: Faculty submits a procurement request and can view its status.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; project with sanctioned budget information exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a procurement request for equipment within budget, then reopens it.
expected_result: Request is recorded; budget/approval-path checks are applied; current status is available to Faculty on reopening.

purpose: Viewing procurement status does not change request state.
preconditions: A submitted procurement request of the Faculty exists.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the request status view twice.
expected_result: Status is returned; request state is identical before and after viewing.

purpose: A procurement request failing sanctioned-budget validation is not advanced.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; project has a sanctioned budget lower than the request amount.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a procurement request exceeding the sanctioned budget.
expected_result: Budget validation fails; request is not advanced as eligible.

purpose: RSPC does not perform procurement/vendor/stock/inventory execution.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a valid procurement request.
expected_result: Only an RSPC request/status record is created; no purchase, vendor, stock-master or inventory operation is executed.

purpose: Faculty submits a progress/utilization report for a due reporting period.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; project with an active reporting period and schedule exists.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the pending reporting item and submits a progress report.
expected_result: Schedule/deadline information is displayed; the report is stored in project history; reporting status updated to submitted.

purpose: A report pending at a represented deadline triggers a reminder notification.
preconditions: Project has a configured reporting deadline that has been reached with the report still pending.
action_or_input: The deadline condition is evaluated.
expected_result: A reporting-reminder notification event is triggered for the responsible Faculty.

purpose: Unauthorized report submission is blocked.
preconditions: Project belongs to Faculty A; user is Faculty B without access.
action_or_input: Faculty B submits a progress report for the project.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; no report stored.

purpose: Submission outside a represented project/reporting context is not accepted.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; referenced project/reporting period does not exist or is inactive.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a report against the non-existent/inactive context.
expected_result: Submission is rejected; no report stored; no project state changed.

purpose: Faculty submits closure/completion report routed to closure verification.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; project is at a closure-reportable point.
action_or_input: Faculty submits completion and closure report information.
expected_result: Closure record is recorded as submitted and available at the RSPC Admin closure-verification stage.

purpose: Unauthorized closure submission is blocked.
preconditions: User lacks Faculty authorization for the project.
action_or_input: User attempts to submit a closure report.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; no closure record created.

purpose: Closure submission does not execute accounting settlement or inventory operations.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a valid closure report.
expected_result: Only an RSPC closure record is created; no settlement or inventory operation is executed.

purpose: Authorized user receives and opens an RSPC notification with its context.
preconditions: A notification exists for an RSPC event on a record the user is authorized for.
action_or_input: User opens the notification area and then the notification.
expected_result: Notification is listed in the dashboard channel; opening it shows the notification and the associated RSPC context.

purpose: Notifications cover the specified event categories.
preconditions: User has notifications arising from proposal submission and approval events.
action_or_input: User opens the notification area.
expected_result: Notifications for each occurred applicable event category (e.g. submission, approval) are available to the user.

purpose: Unauthorized notification context is not disclosed.
preconditions: A notification references a record the requesting user is not authorized for.
action_or_input: User requests that notification/context.
expected_result: Access is denied; no record context disclosed.

purpose: Email-delivery failure does not make RSPC execute its own email infrastructure.
preconditions: Platform email delivery is unavailable (simulated failure of external delivery service).
action_or_input: An RSPC notification event occurs.
expected_result: Dashboard notification remains available; RSPC does not perform its own email delivery; originating record state unaffected.

purpose: RSPC Admin reviews reports, audit logs and integration tracking records.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; historical reports, audit logs and integration tracking records exist.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin opens the reporting/history/audit view.
expected_result: Historical progress/utilization reports, audit/compliance logs and integration tracking records are displayed; no record modified.

purpose: Faculty, Dean-RSPC or Director access only the permitted subset.
preconditions: Records of several projects exist; Faculty owns one project.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the reporting/history view.
expected_result: Faculty sees only reports/histories of permitted (own) projects.

purpose: Unauthorized access to reports/audit records is blocked.
preconditions: User without the required RSPC role is authenticated.
action_or_input: User opens the audit/log view.
expected_result: Access is denied; no records returned.

purpose: The view does not perform external execution or modify records.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; audit and integration records exist.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin opens the audit/integration view.
expected_result: Audit and integration tracking records are unchanged after viewing; no external action performed.

purpose: An authorized role assignment takes effect immediately and is logged.
preconditions: A user without the HoD role exists; the role change comes from the authorized Fusion role-management mechanism.
action_or_input: Fusion role management assigns the RSPC HoD role to the user; the user then attempts an HoD review action on a request at HoD review.
expected_result: The user can immediately perform HoD actions; the role change relevant to RSPC is logged.

purpose: A reassignment (role removal/transfer) takes effect.
preconditions: User U1 holds the RSPC Admin role; it is reassigned to U2 by authorized role management.
action_or_input: U1 and U2 each attempt an RSPC Admin verification action.
expected_result: U1 is now blocked; U2 is permitted; the reassignment is logged.

purpose: RSPC does not create/administer platform-wide accounts or RBAC.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Attempt via RSPC to create a platform user account or platform-wide role.
expected_result: No such RSPC function is available/accepted; no platform account or role is created.

purpose: Role change from an unauthorized source is not applied.
preconditions: A non-authorized user (e.g. Faculty) is authenticated.
action_or_input: The user attempts to assign an RSPC role to themselves/another user.
expected_result: Change is rejected; RSPC access of the target user is unchanged.

purpose: Faculty updates permitted project lifecycle information.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and owns a project in a lifecycle state permitting updates (e.g. draft/active).
action_or_input: Faculty updates project details/milestones/progress.
expected_result: Editable fields are shown; update is validated against lifecycle state and saved; new values retained in the record/history.

purpose: Only the subset of information permitted at the state can be updated.
preconditions: Faculty owns a project in a state where only some fields are editable.
action_or_input: Faculty updates a permitted field.
expected_result: Permitted field update is saved; other fields remain unchanged.

purpose: Update not permitted in the current lifecycle state is blocked.
preconditions: Faculty owns a project that has been submitted/under review (not editable).
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to update project details.
expected_result: Update is blocked; prior project record remains intact.

purpose: Unauthorized project update is blocked.
preconditions: Project belongs to Faculty A; Faculty B is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty B attempts to update the project.
expected_result: Update rejected as unauthorized/not found; record unchanged.

purpose: Faculty records selection participation and recommendation; appointment advances.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; appointment request is at the selection stage requiring Faculty involvement.
action_or_input: Faculty records participation and submits a staff-selection recommendation.
expected_result: Participation/recommendation stored; appointment record advanced to the next approval stage (Dean-RSPC).

purpose: Unauthorized selection records are blocked.
preconditions: Appointment request belongs to Faculty A's project; Faculty B is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty B submits a selection recommendation.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; appointment record unchanged.

purpose: Recording selection does not perform HR master-data or payroll execution.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated; appointment request at selection stage.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a selection recommendation.
expected_result: Only RSPC selection records change; no HR master-data or payroll action executed.

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves an eligible appointment request within authority.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; appointment request is at the Dean-RSPC stage within authority.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC opens the request with selection/verification records and approves.
expected_result: Records are displayed; approval recorded; approval notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC forwards an appointment request requiring Director action.
preconditions: Appointment request requiring Director action is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC forwards it to Director.
expected_result: Forwarding recorded; request at Director stage; escalation notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC does not approve an appointment request.
preconditions: Appointment request is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records a rejection.
expected_result: Rejection outcome recorded; request is not approved.

purpose: Unauthorized appointment decision is blocked.
preconditions: Appointment request at Dean-RSPC stage; acting user is not Dean-RSPC.
action_or_input: User attempts to approve.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; request unchanged.

purpose: Appointment approval does not perform HR/payroll execution.
preconditions: Appointment request at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves.
expected_result: Only RSPC decision record/status changes; no HR/payroll execution.

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves a verified financial request within delegated powers.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; a verified financial request within delegated powers is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC opens the request with verification history and approves.
expected_result: Approval recorded; decision event logged for audit; financial-approval notification event triggered.

source_id: RSPC-UC-024 Main Flow (high-value forward to Director)
purpose: A high-value financial request is forwarded to Director.
preconditions: A verified financial request above delegated powers is at the Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC acts on the request.
expected_result: Request is forwarded to Director (not approved at Dean-RSPC); forwarding event logged; escalation notification event triggered.

purpose: Unauthorized financial decision is blocked.
preconditions: Verified financial request at Dean-RSPC stage; acting user is not Dean-RSPC.
action_or_input: User attempts to approve.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; request unchanged.

purpose: Financial approval does not execute payment/ledger/disbursement.
preconditions: Verified financial request at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves.
expected_result: Only RSPC decision record/status changes; no payment, ledger or disbursement operation executed.

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies a procurement request within budget and forwards it.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a complete procurement request within sanctioned budget exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a positive verification outcome.
expected_result: Budget validation passes; outcome recorded; request forwarded to the approval stage.

purpose: Incomplete/non-compliant/over-budget procurement is not advanced.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a procurement request exceeding the sanctioned budget exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin attempts to verify/forward it.
expected_result: Request is not advanced as eligible.

purpose: Procurement verification does not execute procurement/inventory operations.
preconditions: Procurement request exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin verifies it.
expected_result: Only RSPC verification records change; no vendor, purchase or stock operation executed.

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves a verified procurement request within authority.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; verified procurement request within authority at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves it.
expected_result: Approval recorded; approval notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC forwards a procurement request requiring Director action.
preconditions: Verified procurement request requiring Director action at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC forwards it.
expected_result: Forwarding recorded; request at Director stage; escalation notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC does not approve a procurement request.
preconditions: Verified procurement request at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC rejects it.
expected_result: Rejection outcome recorded; request not approved.

purpose: Unauthorized procurement decision is blocked.
preconditions: Procurement request at Dean-RSPC stage; acting user is not Dean-RSPC.
action_or_input: User attempts to approve.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; request unchanged.

purpose: Procurement approval does not execute procurement/vendor/inventory operations.
preconditions: Verified procurement request at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves.
expected_result: Only RSPC decision record/status changes; no procurement, vendor or inventory operation executed.

purpose: RSPC Admin verifies a closure record with settlement and asset declarations and forwards it.
preconditions: RSPC Admin is authenticated; a complete closure record with financial-settlement and asset-declaration records exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records verification of completeness, settlement and asset declaration as eligible.
expected_result: Verification outcome recorded; closure record forwarded to the Dean-RSPC approval stage.

purpose: An incomplete/ineligible closure record is not forwarded.
preconditions: Closure record lacking the asset-declaration record exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin attempts to verify/forward it.
expected_result: Closure record is not forwarded as eligible.

purpose: Closure verification does not execute settlement or inventory operations.
preconditions: Submitted closure record exists.
action_or_input: RSPC Admin verifies it.
expected_result: Only RSPC verification records change; no accounting settlement or inventory operation executed.

purpose: Dean-RSPC approves closure; the project is archived with its audit trail.
preconditions: Dean-RSPC is authenticated; verified closure record within authority at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records closure approval with closure remarks.
expected_result: Closure decision and remarks recorded; project archived as closed with audit trail retained; approval notification event triggered.

purpose: Dean-RSPC forwards a closure record requiring Director action.
preconditions: Verified closure record requiring Director action at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC forwards it to Director.
expected_result: Forwarding recorded; closure record at Director stage; not yet archived; escalation notification event triggered.

purpose: A non-approved closure is recorded and not archived as approved.
preconditions: Verified closure record at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records a non-approval with remarks.
expected_result: Decision outcome recorded; project is not archived as an approved closed project.

purpose: Unauthorized closure decision is blocked.
preconditions: Closure record at Dean-RSPC stage; acting user is not Dean-RSPC.
action_or_input: User attempts to approve closure.
expected_result: Rejected as unauthorized; project not archived; record unchanged.

purpose: Closure decision does not execute financial settlement or inventory operations.
preconditions: Verified closure record at Dean-RSPC stage.
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC approves closure.
expected_result: Only RSPC closure records/status change; no settlement or inventory operation executed.

purpose: A configured Fusion-module integration exchanges RSPC information and is tracked.
preconditions: An integration with another Fusion module is explicitly configured for RSPC information.
action_or_input: The integrated module sends/requests the configured RSPC information.
expected_result: Context and scope are validated; only the represented information is exchanged/recorded; an integration tracking record is created.

purpose: Unconfigured integration requests are not processed.
preconditions: No integration is configured for the requesting module/information.
action_or_input: An unconfigured module sends an RSPC integration request.
expected_result: Request is rejected and not processed as an authorized integration; no RSPC record changed.

purpose: RSPC does not assume ownership of the other module's process.
preconditions: A configured integration exists.
action_or_input: The integrated module sends RSPC-relevant information.
expected_result: RSPC only records/references the information; no process of the other module is executed by RSPC.

purpose: External funding-agency submission/disbursement status is recorded and visible.
preconditions: External tracking integration is configured; an RSPC project exists.
action_or_input: The integration supplies a disbursement status update for the project.
expected_result: Status recorded against the project and visible to authorized RSPC actors.

purpose: RSPC makes no external-agency decisions and executes no disbursements.
preconditions: External tracking integration is configured.
action_or_input: The integration supplies a disbursement status update.
expected_result: Only the tracking status is recorded; no disbursement or external decision is executed by RSPC.

purpose: Unrepresented/unconfigured external-agency actions are not treated as RSPC-owned.
preconditions: No external tracking integration is configured for the source.
action_or_input: An unconfigured external source supplies a tracking update.
expected_result: Update is not recorded as an RSPC tracking record.

purpose: A supported RSPC process event generates and dispatches a notification to resolved recipients.
preconditions: A proposal and resolvable recipients (e.g. HoD) exist.
action_or_input: A proposal-submission event occurs.
expected_result: Notification category and related record identified; recipient resolved; dashboard notification event created and retained.

purpose: When only one channel applies, only that channel is used.
preconditions: Only the dashboard channel is configured (no email configured).
action_or_input: A supported RSPC event occurs.
expected_result: Notification is created on the dashboard channel only; no email notification is triggered.

purpose: Reporting reminders use the configured reporting schedule.
preconditions: A reporting schedule is configured for a project and a deadline becomes due with the report pending.
action_or_input: The configured due condition is evaluated.
expected_result: A reporting-reminder notification is generated per the configured schedule for the responsible Faculty.

purpose: No reminder/recipient is invented when not configured.
preconditions: No reporting schedule is configured for a project.
action_or_input: Reminder evaluation runs.
expected_result: No reporting-reminder notification is generated for that project; no recipient fabricated.

purpose: Notification dispatch failure does not alter the originating record.
preconditions: External email delivery fails (simulated external dependency failure).
action_or_input: A proposal-submission event occurs and email dispatch is attempted.
expected_result: The originating proposal record/state is unchanged by the failure; RSPC does not execute platform email delivery itself.
